title: Federal Pell Grant - basics
facts: Federal Pell Grants generally provide need-based aid to eligible undergraduate students who have not earned a bachelor's, graduate or professional degree, with limited exceptions for certain postbaccalaureate teacher-certification programs.
A Pell Grant normally does not have to be repaid, except in specified circumstances such as certain enrollment changes or withdrawal situations.
Eligibility and award amount depend on federal student-aid rules including the Student Aid Index, enrollment intensity, cost of attendance and annual statutory parameters.
Lifetime Pell Grant eligibility is generally limited to the equivalent of 12 full-time semesters, expressed as 600% Lifetime Eligibility Used.
